data.exact_reserve_text: Within this profit, there was a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2014 year of account of GBP 13.8m before expenses and investment return. This arose largely from a reduction in the 2014 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2017.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in the 2014 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2017, contributing to a profit on reinsurance to close

named_events.loss_description: The current incurred loss from the hurricanes of late 2017 to the whole account is a gross loss of US$6.5 million and a net amount of US$4.6 million.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were GBP 271.047m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a modest overall adverse prior-year development of GBP 2.966m (1.09% of opening reserves), driven mainly by adverse movement in the 2015 underwriting year partially offset by releases in older years. However, management also reports a material release relating to 2014 and prior years following favourable settlements (reflected in the reinsurance-to-close result), and exchange rate movements and RITC activity have materially affected comparatives. Movements were concentrated in casualty and reinsurance lines with smaller movements in property and accident & health.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages showing incurred and ultimate by underwriting year). The reconciliation in the reinsurance-to-close notes shows a substantial gross release for 2014 & prior (-GBP 16.108m) which is a narrower vintage subset; exchange rate movements and RITC entries materially affect comparatives. Hurricanes losses are quoted in USD in the report and have not been converted. Where only net figures appeared in notes, a gross triangle was used as the primary source.
